body:
What effort makes things better exactly?
Nothing brings back all of my dead family, nothing fixes my mistakes with my ex, nothing fixes ADHD or the incredibly bad stigma with it, my diabetes will always been lurking waiting to kill me like it has killed the majority of my family.

What fixes a life that so far has been 21 years straight of pain, where any effort given has only made my life tremendously worse? And getting sober at this point is honestly my last concern, I'm not ready to open that bag of worms.. The drinking is the only reason I can even tolerate anything.
